description: This file defines a final class 'Serializer' that handles serialization and deserialization of HTTP responses, including converting responses to and from strings and streams, and extracting status lines.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A final class responsible for serializing and deserializing HTTP response messages, including converting responses to strings and parsing responses from streams.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Deserializes a response string into a Response object.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Parses a Response object from a stream.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Creates a string representation of a Response object.

methods.name: getStatusLine
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP version, status code, and reason phrase from a stream's status line.
